verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; organic presence is active but softening.
narrative: This period, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google — zero spend, zero leads, and no click data to evaluate. Your Google Business Profile carried all engagement, generating 164 total actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) across three locations over the last 28 days. In the most recent 7 days, however, those organic actions dropped 26% versus the prior 7 days, and the last 3 days show the decline accelerating. Your profiles are still appearing in search — logging over 1,100 impressions this period — but without paid campaigns driving additional traffic, the organic signal alone is not converting at the rate your business needs.
